segments.source: Manage the playback of media assets and interstitial content, independent of how you present that content in your interface.
segments.ko: 미디어 자산과 인터스티셜 콘텐츠의 재생을 인터페이스에서 해당 콘텐츠를 표시하는 방식과 독립적으로 관리합니다.

segments.source: You use a player to manage the playback and timing of a media asset, for example starting and stopping playback, and seeking to a particular time.
segments.ko: 플레이어를 사용해 미디어 자산의 재생과 타이밍(시작, 중지, 특정 시점으로의 탐색)을 관리할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: A player manages the playback of a single media asset at a time.
segments.ko: 플레이어는 한 번에 하나의 미디어 자산만 재생을 관리합니다.

segments.source: The framework also provides a queue player that queues media assets to play sequentially.
segments.ko: 이 framework는 미디어 자산을 차례대로 재생하도록 큐에 넣어 순차 재생하는 queue player도 제공합니다.

segments.source: **Note**: When you use AVFoundation, Apple may collect metrics to help improve the framework.
segments.ko: **Note**: AVFoundation을 사용할 때 Apple은 framework 개선에 도움이 되도록 메트릭을 수집할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: You create an instance of [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md) to play a media asset.
A player item manages the timing and presentation state of an asset played by the player.
segments.ko: player item은 플레이어가 재생하는 자산의 타이밍과 표시 상태를 관리합니다.

segments.source: A player item also contains player item tracks that correspond to the tracks in the asset.
segments.ko: player item에는 자산의 트랙에 해당하는 player item track도 포함됩니다.

segments.source: You direct the output of a player to a specialized Core Animation layer, a player layer, or a synchronized layer.
segments.ko: 플레이어 출력을 특수 Core Animation layer, player layer 또는 synchronized layer로 전달합니다.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: You must call the [`VTRegisterProfessionalVideoWorkflowVideoDecoders()`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTRegisterProfessionalVideoWorkflowVideoDecoders()) function if your app requires Afterburner accelerated playback and decoding of ProRes and ProRes RAW video files.
segments.ko: ❗ **Important**: 앱이 ProRes 및 ProRes RAW 비디오 파일의 Afterburner 가속 재생과 디코딩이 필요할 경우 [`VTRegisterProfessionalVideoWorkflowVideoDecoders()`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/VideoToolbox/VTRegisterProfessionalVideoWorkflowVideoDecoders()) 함수를 호출해야 합니다.

segments.source: Configure apps to enable standard media playback behavior.
segments.ko: 표준 미디어 재생 동작을 활성화하도록 앱을 구성합니다.

segments.source: Keep your user interface in sync with state changes from playback objects.
segments.ko: 재생 객체의 상태 변경에 맞춰 사용자 인터페이스 상태를 동기화합니다.

segments.source: Play, pause, and seek through a media presentation.
segments.ko: 미디어 프레젠테이션에서 재생, 일시 중지, 탐색을 수행합니다.

segments.source: Build advanced multiview playback experiences with the AVFoundation and AVRouting frameworks.
segments.ko: AVFoundation 및 AVRouting framework로 고급 멀티뷰 재생 경험을 구축합니다.

segments.source: An object that provides the interface to control the player’s transport behavior.
segments.ko: 플레이어의 전송 동작을 제어하는 인터페이스를 제공하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that models the timing and presentation state of an asset during playback.
segments.ko: 재생 중 자산의 타이밍과 표시 상태를 모델링하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that represents the presentation state of an asset track during playback.
segments.ko: 재생 중 자산 트랙의 표시 상태를 나타내는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that plays a sequence of player items.
An object that loops media content using a queue player.
segments.ko: queue player를 사용해 미디어 콘텐츠를 반복 재생하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: Leverage SwiftUI to build an immersive media experience in a multiplatform app.
segments.ko: SwiftUI를 활용해 멀티플랫폼 앱에서 몰입형 미디어 경험을 구축합니다.

segments.source: Create synchronized media experiences that enable users to watch and listen across devices.
segments.ko: 기기 간에 시청 및 청취를 지원하는 동기화된 미디어 경험을 만듭니다.

segments.source: An object that coordinates the playback of players in a connected group.
segments.ko: 연결된 그룹에서 플레이어 재생을 조정하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: A playback coordinator subclass that coordinates the playback of player objects in a connected group.
segments.ko: 연결된 그룹에서 player 객체의 재생을 조정하는 playback coordinator 하위 클래스입니다.

segments.source: A playback coordinator subclass that coordinates the playback of custom player objects in a connected group.
segments.ko: 연결된 그룹에서 사용자 지정 player 객체의 재생을 조정하는 playback coordinator 하위 클래스입니다.

segments.source: Observe the playback of a media asset to update your app’s user-interface state.
segments.ko: 미디어 자산의 재생을 관찰하여 앱의 사용자 인터페이스 상태를 업데이트합니다.

segments.source: Play, write, and export HEVC video with an alpha channel to add overlay effects to your video processing.
segments.ko: 알파 채널이 있는 HEVC 비디오를 재생하고, 쓰고, 내보내어 비디오 처리에 오버레이 효과를 추가합니다.

segments.source: An object that presents the visual contents of a player object.
segments.ko: player 객체의 시각적 콘텐츠를 표시하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: A Core Animation layer that derives its timing from a player item so that you can synchronize layer animations with media playback.
segments.ko: player item에서 타이밍을 파생해 레이어 애니메이션을 미디어 재생과 동기화할 수 있는 Core Animation layer입니다.

segments.source: Extend your app’s appeal to users by adding subtitles and alternative audio tracks in their native language.
segments.ko: 사용자의 기본 언어로 자막과 대체 오디오 트랙을 추가해 앱의 사용자 접근성을 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.source: An object that represents a complete rendition of media selection options on an asset.
segments.ko: 자산의 미디어 선택 옵션 전체를 나타내는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that represents a collection of mutually exclusive options for the presentation of media within an asset.
segments.ko: 자산 내 미디어 표시를 위한 상호 배타적 옵션 컬렉션을 나타내는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that represents a specific option for the presentation of media within a group of options.
segments.ko: 옵션 그룹에서 미디어 표시를 위해 특정 옵션을 나타내는 객체입니다.

segments.source: A mutable object that represents a complete rendition of media selection options on an asset.
segments.ko: 자산의 미디어 선택 옵션 전체를 나타내는 변경 가능한 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that specifies the preferred languages and media characteristics for a player.
segments.ko: 플레이어에 대한 기본 언어와 미디어 특성을 지정하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: For content that has been authored with the express intent of offering an alternative selection interface for AVMediaSelectionOptions, AVCustomMediaSelectionScheme provides a collection of custom settings for controlling the presentation of the media.
segments.ko: AVMediaSelectionOptions에 대한 대체 선택 인터페이스 제공을 목적으로 제작된 콘텐츠의 경우, AVCustomMediaSelectionScheme은 미디어 표시를 제어하기 위한 사용자 지정 설정 컬렉션을 제공합니다.

segments.source: For content that has been authored with the express intent of offering an alternative selection interface for AVMediaSelectionOptions, AVMediaPresentationSelector represents a collection of mutually exclusive settings.
segments.ko: AVMediaSelectionOptions에 대한 대체 선택 인터페이스 제공을 목적으로 제작된 콘텐츠의 경우, AVMediaPresentationSelector는 미디어 표시를 제어하는 상호 배타적 설정 컬렉션을 나타냅니다.

segments.source: For content that has been authored with the express intent of offering an alternative selection interface for AVMediaSelectionOptions, AVMediaPresentationSetting represents a selectable setting for controlling the presentation of the media.
segments.ko: AVMediaSelectionOptions에 대한 대체 선택 인터페이스 제공을 목적으로 제작된 콘텐츠의 경우, AVMediaPresentationSetting은 미디어 표시를 제어하는 선택 가능한 설정을 나타냅니다.

segments.source: [Providing an integrated view of your timeline when playing HLS interstitials](providing-an-integrated-view-of-your-timeline-when-playing-hls-interstitials.md)
segments.ko: [Providing an integrated view of your timeline when playing HLS interstitials](providing-an-integrated-view-of-your-timeline-when-playing-hls-interstitials.md)

segments.source: Go beyond simple ad insertion with point and fill occupancy HLS interstitials.
segments.ko: point and fill occupancy HLS interstitials로 단순 광고 삽입을 넘어선 기능을 구현합니다.

segments.source: An object that provides instructions for how a player presents interstitial content.
segments.ko: 플레이어가 interstitial 콘텐츠를 표시하는 방식을 지정하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that schedules interstitial events for items played by the primary player.
segments.ko: 기본 플레이어에서 재생되는 항목의 interstitial 이벤트를 예약하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that monitors the scheduling and progress of interstitial events.
segments.ko: interstitial 이벤트의 예약 및 진행 상태를 모니터링하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An object that models the timeline and playback sequence of a primary player item and scheduled interstitial events.
segments.ko: 주요 player item과 예약된 interstitial 이벤트의 타임라인 및 재생 순서를 모델링하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: An asynchronous stream of metric information.
segments.ko: 메트릭 정보를 비동기로 스트리밍하는 정보 흐름입니다.

segments.source: An asynchronous stream of metric information from different publishers.
segments.ko: 서로 다른 게시자로부터 메트릭 정보를 비동기적으로 스트리밍하는 메트릭입니다.

segments.source: An object that provides metrics related to video playback quality.
segments.ko: 비디오 재생 품질과 관련된 메트릭을 제공하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: A type for objects that publish metric events to the event stream.
segments.ko: 이벤트 스트림에 metric 이벤트를 게시하는 객체를 위한 type입니다.

segments.source: A base class that represents a metric event.
An object that represents a metric event when an error occurs.
segments.ko: 오류가 발생할 때 metric event를 나타내는 객체입니다.

segments.source: Set up your app to support remote commands and events in a variety of scenarios by using the relevant approach.
segments.ko: Set up your app to support remote commands and events in a variety of scenarios by using the relevant approach.

segments.source: Add chapter markers to enable users to quickly navigate your content.
segments.ko: Add chapter markers to enable users to quickly navigate your content.

segments.source: A collection of metadata items associated with a timeline segment.
segments.ko: A collection of metadata items associated with a timeline segment.

segments.source: A collection of metadata items that are valid for use during a specific time range.
segments.ko: A collection of metadata items that are valid for use during a specific time range.

segments.source: A mutable collection of metadata items that are valid for use during a specific time range.
segments.ko: A mutable collection of metadata items that are valid for use during a specific time range.

segments.source: A collection of metadata items that are valid for use within a specific date range.
segments.ko: A collection of metadata items that are valid for use within a specific date range.

segments.source: A mutable collection of metadata items that are valid for use within a specific range of dates.
segments.ko: A mutable collection of metadata items that are valid for use within a specific range of dates.

segments.source: The abstract base for media data collectors.
segments.ko: The abstract base for media data collectors.

segments.source: An object used to capture the date range metadata defined for an HTTP Live Streaming asset.
segments.ko: An object used to capture the date range metadata defined for an HTTP Live Streaming asset.

segments.source: An object that receives video data from a player object.
segments.ko: An object that receives video data from a player object.

segments.source: An object that specifies the pixel buffer attributes and tag collections handled by a player video output.
segments.ko: An object that specifies the pixel buffer attributes and tag collections handled by a player video output.

segments.source: An abstract class that defines the common interface to output media data from a player item.
segments.ko: An abstract class that defines the common interface to output media data from a player item.

segments.source: An object that outputs video frames from a player item.
segments.ko: An object that outputs video frames from a player item.

segments.source: An object that vends attributed strings for media with a legible characteristic.
segments.ko: An object that vends attributed strings for media with a legible characteristic.

segments.source: A player item output that vends media with a legible characteristic as rendered pixel buffers.
segments.ko: A player item output that vends media with a legible characteristic as rendered pixel buffers.

segments.source: An object that provides a rendered pixel buffer and its position in pixels.
segments.ko: An object that provides a rendered pixel buffer and its position in pixels.

segments.source: An object that vends collections of metadata items that a player item’s tracks carry.
segments.ko: An object that vends collections of metadata items that a player item’s tracks carry.

segments.source: A protocol that defines the methods to implement to respond to changes in the media data sequence.
segments.ko: A protocol that defines the methods to implement to respond to changes in the media data sequence.

segments.source: An object that provides playback information for an asset.
segments.ko: An object that provides playback information for an asset.

segments.source: A structure that defines playback configuration options for an asset.
segments.ko: A structure that defines playback configuration options for an asset.

segments.source: Download streamed content to disk to allow offline playback, and define policies to automatically remove downloaded assets.
segments.ko: Download streamed content to disk to allow offline playback, and define policies to automatically remove downloaded assets.

segments.source: Stream content wirelessly to other devices using AirPlay, and handle requests involving FairPlay-protected assets.
segments.ko: Stream content wirelessly to other devices using AirPlay, and handle requests involving FairPlay-protected assets.

segments.source: Create custom controllers to play and synchronize the timing of sample buffer streams.
segments.ko: Create custom controllers to play and synchronize the timing of sample buffer streams.
